title: Young Brothers, Baby Boy in High Chair - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor snapshot from the American post-WWII baby boom era depicting two young brothers outside of a home. A shirtless older toddler wearing denim overalls with visible sun tan lines stands holding onto a wooden high chair where his baby sibling sits, looking toward the camera. In the background, the shingle-sided exterior of the house features a window and outdoor clothesline.
